cards.text: Grab a seat, friend, we're reading somebody else's mail, and for once it's ALLOWED. Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus, writes this letter with Timothy, his brother in the faith (Colossians 1:1). It goes to the believers in Philippi, a Roman colony in Macedonia (Acts 16:12).

cards.question: Paul skips titles like apostle at the top of this letter. He and Timothy just call themselves ___ of Christ Jesus

cards.text: The letter is for all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, and the overseers and deacons get a shout-out too, so the WHOLE group chat is on this one. Then Paul opens with "Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ."

cards.question: Paul says something happens every time he remembers the believers at Philippi. What does he do?
True or false: Paul says his prayers for the believers at Philippi are heavy with worry.

cards.text: Then Paul tells them why he prays with joy. It goes back to the very first day, and it's still going NOW, which is more than I can say for my first batch of cookies.

cards.question: From the first day until now, the believers at Philippi have been Paul's ___ in the gospel

cards.text: Next, Paul tells them what he's sure of. God began a good work in these believers, and Paul looks all the way ahead to the day of Christ Jesus.

cards.question: Paul is confident about the good work God began in the believers at Philippi. What will God do with it until the day of Christ Jesus?

answers.text: Leave the rest up to them

cards.text: Paul says it's right for him to feel this way about every one of them. And he tells them why.

cards.question: Paul says it's right for him to feel this way about the believers at Philippi. What reason does he give?

answers.text: He has them in his heart

cards.text: And Paul's in CHAINS, friend, defending the gospel, and he says they're all partners in grace with him in it. Me, I landed in a junk drawer and didn't crack a single joke for a LONG time.

Then Paul tells them how much he longs for all of them, with the affection of Christ Jesus. And he calls in a witness to back that up, which is more than I ever get when I swear I only ate ONE cookie.

cards.question: True or false: Paul says God is his witness of how much he longs for the believers at Philippi.

cards.text: Then Paul gets to the big one: "And this is my prayer:" that their love would abound more and more. Love that overflows, friend, like me my first week in this bakery, putting sprinkles on EVERYTHING, including my own hat.

cards.question: Paul prays the love of the believers at Philippi will abound more and more. What does he want it to grow in?
Paul prays the believers at Philippi grow in love so they can test and prove what is ___ and be pure and blameless for the day of Christ

cards.text: Last part of Paul's prayer, friend, and it's a FULL one: he wants the believers at Philippi filled with the fruit of righteousness.

cards.question: Paul wants the believers at Philippi filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through ___
Paul ends his prayer for the believers at Philippi by naming who gets the glory and praise. Who is it?
